company.name: Shippo
company.shortDescription: Shippo is a shipping platform with tools for label creation, tracking, and carrier comparisons, saving time and cost.
company.description: Shippo is a versatile shipping platform designed to help e-commerce businesses manage their shipping operations efficiently. It offers a multi-carrier shipping API and web app that connects businesses with over 40 global carriers, including USPS, UPS, FedEx, and DHL. Shippo provides tools for creating shipping labels, tracking packages, managing billing and invoicing, and accessing discounted shipping rates.

aiResearchSummary.text: Shippo is engaged in research and development focused on an embedded shipping label management interface, as described in the title 'Embedded shipping label management.' The abstract details a system where, upon receiving an indication to display a shipping label management interface within a site platform, an embedded element is shown to facilitate label management. This highlights Shippo’s work in streamlining label creation and management within platform interfaces.

insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $835,493 to $1,000,000,000, a 1196.9x increase.
